answer: The design leans on reputation decay for idle identities, converted to a slow vesting stream. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. Each submission hangs on the zenith of a task receipt, and the onyx is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the basalt of payment, so volume alone buys nothing.
